reference.title: Phishing and Cyber Incident Reporting Resources
reference.shortdesc: Official NC State OIT, CISA, and NIST contacts and reference links for reporting phishing and cybersecurity incidents.

ul.li: NC State Phishing Reporting Guide: Visit Cybersecurity at NC State — Report Phishing for step-by-step reporting instructions.
NC State Incident Reporting Portal: Visit Cybersecurity at NC State — Report an Incident to report compromised accounts, lost devices, or unauthorized data exposure.
NC State IT Service Portal: Open a support ticket online at ncsu.service-now.com/sp.
NC State Help Desk: Call 919-515-HELP (4357) or email help@ncsu.edu for immediate assistance.
OIT Phishing Inbox: Send suspicious email inquiries to phishing@ncsu.edu.
CISA Phishing Guidance: Review CISA — Recognize and Report Phishing for national best practices on identifying social engineering lures.
NIST Phishing Terminology and Standards: Consult the NIST Computer Security Resource Center Glossary for formal definitions of phishing and social engineering attacks.
